name: Bound keys only: the setting, its audited switch, and a preview that says what it did not decide
summary: bound_keys_only (deployment.private.json; absent/false is off) makes the wrapper refuse a line lacking a project or a principal; the switch (status/on/off, operator-gated, audited, off) previews what on would cut off, in three groups. REFUSED: the command IS this kit's wrapper invocation (interpreter + short flags only; a relay, ssh, env or an assignment is group two), no shell (whitelist: alnum, -_.+/=,: space; a tab or non-ASCII letter is shell), this kit's wrapper by an absolute path of at most 512 bytes, an absolute --root, unbound - would_be_refused (twenty numbers, _more, truncated) everywhere. MAY BE REFUSED: every other command= line - another wrapper/root, shell syntax, a relative path, another program - printed by status and on as may_be_refused with _more, both groups printed BEFORE the write, wrapper_names_setting saying as a HINT whether the wrapper names the setting in its first 64 KiB of the OPEN descriptor (once per file; a fifo never opened); a word in a file is a hint, not a decision. on REFUSES to flip on an unreadable or partly-inspected keys file unless --without-preview is said; a NUL or over-long wrapper path costs one line.
